4. The appellant took the stand; (a) that the application under sections 38 and 162 of the Companies Act cannot be joined together. The petition is liable to be dismissed on the ground of misjoinder, (b) the respondents could not be registered as share-holder in place of late MA Jalil inasmuch as, the heirs did not file any Succession Certificate to the Company, (c) the heirs of MA Jalil did not comply with the legal formalities as provided in the Articles of Association before their names could be entered into the Share-Register, (d) since their names were not mutated as share-holders they cannot attend any meeting of the company as such the question of issuing notice of the meeting of the Company and or Board of Directors did not arise, (e) lastly the application is barred by limitation, acquiescence and estoppels. 

 5. The company Judge then considered that the prayer of the appellant for hearing two issues, namely-(i) Is the application maintainable in its present form? (ii) Is the application bad for misjoinder of causes of action as preliminary issue under Order XIV, rule 2 CPC.
